title: Tinglash: tafsilotlarni ushlash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida qisqa inglizcha audioda raqam, ism va sababni ilib olasiz, javobni oldindan taxmin qilasiz, signal so‘zlarga tayanasiz va javoblaringizni tekshira olasiz.

scenes.title: Tafsilotlarni ushlash
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda o‘qishda asosiy g‘oyani topishni o‘rgandik. Bugun tinglash ko‘nikmasining boshqa tomoni: aniq tafsilotlarni ushlash. Raqam, ism va sababni eshitib yozib olishni, javobni oldindan taxmin qilishni, signal so‘zlarga tayanishni va javoblarni tekshirishni mashq qilamiz. Dars oxirida qisqa audioda kerakli ma’lumotni aniq topa olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we looked for the main idea when reading. Today we listen for details: numbers, names and reasons. By the end, you will catch exactly the information you need.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar o‘qishda asosiy g‘oyani qidirdik. Bugun tafsilotlarni tinglaymiz: raqam, ism va sabablar. Dars oxirida aynan kerakli ma’lumotni ilib olasiz.

scenes.title: Nima uchun tafsilot qiyin?
scenes.say_native: Tinglash o‘qishdan qiyin, chunki audio tez o‘tadi, ortga qaytib bo‘lmaydi. Imtihonda ko‘pincha bir-ikki marta eshitasiz. Yana bir sabab: tez nutqda so‘zlar bir-biriga ulanib ketadi. Eng yomoni, o‘quvchilar har bir so‘zni tushunishga urinib, keyingi gapni o‘tkazib yuboradi.
scenes.say: Listening is hard because the speaker does not wait. You often hear the audio only once. Do not try to understand every word. Catch only the detail the question asks for.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglash qiyin, chunki so‘zlovchi kutmaydi. Audioni ko‘pincha bir marta eshitasiz. Har so‘zni tushunishga urinmang. Faqat savol so‘ragan tafsilotni ilib oling.

scenes.title: Avval savolni o‘qing
board: Read the questions BEFORE the audio
Underline: who · when · how many · why
Decide what kind of answer: number? name? reason?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi qoida: audio boshlanishidan oldin savollarni o‘qing. So‘roq so‘zlarini belgilang: kim, qachon, nechta, nima uchun. “How much” bo‘lsa, narx eshitasiz. “Who” bo‘lsa, ism. “Why” bo‘lsa, sabab. Shunda quloq tayyor bo‘ladi va kerakli joyni darhol payqaydi.
scenes.say: Read the questions before you listen. Underline question words like who, when, how much and why. Then you know what kind of answer to wait for.
scenes.say_uz: Tinglashdan oldin savollarni o‘qing. Who, when, how much, why kabi so‘zlarni belgilang. Shunda qanday javob kutishni bilasiz.

scenes.title: Javobni oldindan taxmin qiling
board: When…? → a time, a day, a date
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi qoida: javob turini taxmin qiling. “How much” savoliga narx kelishini bilasiz, demak pul belgisi va raqam kutasiz. “When” savoliga vaqt yoki kun. “Why” savoliga sabab, ya’ni “because” yoki “so”. Taxmin qilish miyani tayyorlaydi, shuning uchun tez nutqda ham kerakli so‘zni ajratib olasiz.
scenes.say: Predict the type of answer. How much means a price. When means a time or a date. Why means a reason, often after because. Prediction prepares your ears.
scenes.say_uz: Javob turini taxmin qiling. How much narxni, when vaqtni, why sababni bildiradi. Taxmin quloqni tayyorlaydi.

scenes.title: Raqamlarni eshitish: 13 va 30
scenes.say_native: Raqamlar tinglashdagi eng katta tuzoq. “Thirteen” va “thirty” juda o‘xshash. Farq urg‘uda: “thirteen” da urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda, “thir-TEEN”, “thirty” da birinchisida, “THIR-ty”. Xuddi shunday “fifteen” va “fifty”, “sixteen” va “sixty”. Ikkinchi nuqta: “teen” uzun va aniq eshitiladi, “ty” esa qisqa.
scenes.say: Thirteen and thirty sound similar. In thirteen, the stress is at the end: thir-TEEN. In thirty, the stress is at the start: THIR-ty. It is the same with fifteen and fifty, and sixteen and sixty.
scenes.say_uz: Thirteen va thirty o‘xshash eshitiladi. Thirteen da urg‘u oxirida, thirty da boshida. Fifteen va fifty, sixteen va sixty ham shunday.

scenes.title: Teen va ty ni adashtirish
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p o‘quvchi “fifteen” ni eshitib “fifty” deb yozadi yoki aksincha. Natijada javob noto‘g‘ri. Yana bir tuzoq: narxdagi “four fifty” ni 450 deb yozish, aslida bu 4.50. Kontekst yordam beradi: chipta qimmat emas, demak 4.50 ehtimoli yuqori.
scenes.say: Many learners confuse fifteen and fifty. Listen for the stress. And remember that four fifty in a price means four pounds fifty, not four hundred and fifty.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p o‘quvchi fifteen va fifty ni adashtiradi. Urg‘uga quloq soling. Narxda four fifty to‘rt funt ellik penni bildiradi, 450 emas.

scenes.title: Raqamni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Men to‘rtta raqamni aytaman, siz qaysi variant ekanini topasiz. Birinchi: thirteen. Ikkinchi: fifty. Uchinchi: sixteen. To‘rtinchi: forty. Har birining raqamini baland ovozda ayting. Urg‘uga quloq soling.
scenes.say: One: thirteen. Two: fifty. Three: sixteen. Four: forty. Which number is it each time?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: thirteen. Ikki: fifty. Uch: sixteen. To‘rt: forty. Har safar qaysi raqam?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: thirteen, ya’ni o‘n uch. Ikkinchi: fifty, ya’ni ellik. Uchinchi: sixteen, o‘n olti. To‘rtinchi: forty, qirq. E’tibor bering: “forty” va “fourteen” ham farqlanadi, “forty” da “u” harfi yozuvda yo‘q, “fourteen” da bor. Imlo ham yordam beradi: forty to‘rtinchi raqamdan “u” siz yoziladi.
scenes.say: One: thirteen. Two: fifty. Three: sixteen. Four: forty. Notice that forty is spelled without a u.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: o‘n uch. Ikki: ellik. Uch: o‘n olti. To‘rt: qirq. Forty u harfisiz yozilishiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Sanalar, vaqt va telefon raqami

examples.t: My number is oh seven double five.

scenes.say_native: Telefon raqamlarida nolni ko‘pincha “oh” deymiz, ikkita bir xil raqam “double”, uchta “triple”. Masalan, “oh seven double five” bu 0755. Vaqtni “two thirty” yoki “half past two” deb ham aytishadi. Sanalarda Britaniyada “the fourth of July”, Amerikada “July the fourth”.
scenes.say: In phone numbers, zero is often said as oh. Two of the same digit is double, and three is triple. So oh seven double five is zero seven five five.
scenes.say_uz: Telefon raqamida nol ko‘pincha oh deyiladi. Ikkita bir xil raqam double, uchtasi triple. Oh seven double five bu 0755.

scenes.title: Ismlar va harflab aytish
scenes.say_native: Ismlar ko‘pincha harflab aytiladi. Harf nomlarini yaxshi bilish kerak: “G” bu “jee”, “J” bu “jay”, “E” bu “ee”, “I” bu “eye”. Adashadigan juftliklar: B va P, M va N, F va S. Uzun “W” ni “double-u” deyishadi. Ismni tinglaganda harflarni darhol yozib boring, so‘zni tushunishga urinmang.
scenes.say: When people spell a name, write each letter as you hear it. G is jee, J is jay, E is ee and I is eye. Be careful with B and P, M and N.
scenes.say_uz: Ism harflab aytilganda, har harfni eshitganingizcha yozing. G jee, J jay. B va P, M va N ga ehtiyot bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Ismni yozib oling
scenes.say_native: Ikkita ismni harflab aytaman, siz yozib oling. Birinchi: J, A, C, K, S, O, N. Ikkinchi: M, A, R, T, I, N, E, Z. Harflarni daftaringizga ketma-ket yozing, keyin to‘liq ismni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.
scenes.say: Write the names. One: J, A, C, K, S, O, N. Two: M, A, R, T, I, N, E, Z.
scenes.say_uz: Ismlarni yozing. Bir: J, A, C, K, S, O, N. Ikki: M, A, R, T, I, N, E, Z.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Jackson. Ikkinchi: Martinez. Agar “Jackson” da “J” va “G” ni adashtirgan bo‘lsangiz, bu tabiiy. Uzoq ismni tinglaganda harflarni yozib borish usuli ishlaydi. Ismlarni aytib bo‘lgach ularni qaytarib tasdiqlash ham mumkin, chunki real hayotda “Is that J-A-C-K-S-O-N?” deb so‘rash odatiy.
scenes.say: One: Jackson. Two: Martinez. In real life you can also check: Is that J-A-C-K-S-O-N?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Jackson. Ikki: Martinez. Hayotda tasdiqlab so‘rash mumkin: Is that J-A-C-K-S-O-N?

scenes.title: Signal so‘zlar: javob yaqin
board: But · However · Actually → the real answer
Another thing · Also → one more detail

examples.t: I wanted Friday, but it was full, so I chose Monday.
examples.uz: Juma kunini istagandim, lekin band edi, shuning uchun dushanbani tanladim.

scenes.say_native: Signal so‘zlar javobning yaqinligini bildiradi. “But”, “however”, “actually” dan keyin ko‘pincha so‘zlovchi fikrini o‘zgartiradi va haqiqiy javob keladi. “First, then, after that” tartibni, “also” va “another thing” yana bir tafsilotni, “so” va “that’s why” natijani ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Signpost words tell you where the answer is. After but, however or actually, the speaker often corrects the first idea. I wanted Friday, but it was full, so I chose Monday. The answer is Monday.
scenes.say_uz: Signal so‘zlar javob qayerdaligini aytadi. But, however, actually dan keyin so‘zlovchi ko‘pincha avvalgi fikrini tuzatadi. Javob dushanba.

scenes.title: Birinchi eshitganga yopishib olish
board: ✗ Writing the first number you hear
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan tuzoq: birinchi eshitgan raqam yoki so‘zni yozib qo‘yish. Imtihon tuzuvchilari ataylab so‘zlovchining fikrini o‘zgartiradi: “It’s at three… no, sorry, four”. Agar siz “three” deb yozsangiz, xato qilasiz. Tuzatish iboralariga, ya’ni “sorry”, “no, wait”, “I mean”, “actually” ga diqqat qiling.
scenes.say: Do not write the first number you hear. Speakers often change their mind: It's at three... no, sorry, four. Listen for corrections like sorry, I mean and actually.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi eshitgan raqamni yozmang. So‘zlovchilar fikrini o‘zgartiradi: soat uchda... yo‘q, kechirasiz, to‘rtda. Sorry, I mean, actually kabi tuzatishlarni tinglang.

scenes.title: Birinchi tinglash: kinoteatr
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Do‘stlar kino chiptasi band qilmoqda. Uch savolga javob toping: qaysi film, soat nechada va chipta narxi qancha. Signal so‘zlarga va tuzatishlarga e’tibor bering. Hozir savollarni yana bir marta o‘qib oling.
scenes.say: Shall we see the new comedy? Well, I'd rather see the thriller, but it's sold out. Okay, the comedy then. The show is at seven thirty. No, sorry, seven forty-five. Tickets are twelve pounds, but students pay nine.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi komediyani ko‘ramizmi? Men triller ko‘rgim kelardi, lekin chiptalar tugagan. Mayli, unda komediya. Seans yetti o‘ttizda. Yo‘q, kechirasiz, yetti qirq beshda. Chipta o‘n ikki funt, lekin talabalar to‘qqiz funt to‘laydi.

scenes.title: Javoblarni yozing
scenes.say_native: Uch savol. Birinchi: ular qaysi filmni ko‘radi? Ikkinchi: seans soat nechada? Uchinchi: talabalar chipta uchun qancha to‘laydi? Eslang: tuzatishlarga e’tibor bering. Xotirangizdan javob bering.
scenes.say: Question one: which film do they see? Question two: what time is the show? Question three: how much do students pay?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ular qaysi filmni ko‘radi? Ikki: seans soat nechada? Uch: talabalar qancha to‘laydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: komediya, chunki trillerning chiptalari tugagan, “but it’s sold out”. Ikkinchi: yetti qirq besh, chunki “No, sorry” dan keyin vaqt tuzatildi. Uchinchi: to‘qqiz funt, chunki “but students pay nine”, ya’ni “but” dan keyin haqiqiy ma’lumot keldi.
scenes.say: One: the comedy. Two: seven forty-five. Three: nine pounds. In all three cases the first thing you heard was not the answer.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: komediya. Ikki: yetti qirq besh. Uch: to‘qqiz funt. Uchala holatda ham birinchi eshitganingiz javob emas edi.

scenes.title: Sabablarni tinglash
board: The reason is… · The problem was…

examples.t: We were late because of the traffic.
We were late because the bus broke down.

scenes.say_native: Sababni bildiruvchi iboralarga quloq soling. “Because” dan keyin gap keladi: “because the bus broke down”. “Because of” va “due to” dan keyin ot keladi: “because of the traffic”. “So” va “that’s why” esa natijani aytadi, sabab undan oldin turadi. Savol “Why” bo‘lsa, “because” dan keyingi qismni yozing.
scenes.say: Listen for reason words. Because is followed by a clause. Because of and due to are followed by a noun. After so and that's why, you hear the result.
scenes.say_uz: Sabab so‘zlariga quloq soling. Because dan keyin gap, because of va due to dan keyin ot keladi. So va that's why dan keyin natija keladi.

scenes.title: Sababni toping
board: 2) Why did she change her flight?
scenes.say_native: Ikkita qisqa gapni eshiting. Birinchi: “Sam was late because of the strike, so he missed the meeting”. Ikkinchi: “She changed her flight since the first one was too early”. Sam nega kech qoldi? U nega reysni o‘zgartirdi? Javoblarni ayting.
scenes.say: One: Sam was late because of the strike, so he missed the meeting. Two: She changed her flight since the first one was too early. Why was Sam late? Why did she change her flight?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Sem ish tashlash tufayli kech qoldi, shuning uchun majlisni o‘tkazib yubordi. Ikki: u birinchi reys juda erta bo‘lgani uchun reysni o‘zgartirdi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) The first flight was too early
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ish tashlash tufayli. “Because of” dan keyin “the strike” ot keldi. “So he missed the meeting” esa natija, savol uni so‘ramaydi. Ikkinchi: birinchi reys juda erta bo‘lgani uchun. “Since” bu yerda “chunki” ma’nosida, vaqtni bildirmaydi.
scenes.say: One: because of the strike. Two: the first flight was too early. Remember, so he missed the meeting is the result, not the reason.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: ish tashlash tufayli. Ikki: birinchi reys juda erta edi. So he missed the meeting natija, sabab emas.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar
scenes.say_native: Tinglashdagi ikkinchi katta tuzoq: kuchsiz shakllar. Gapda “can” odatda kuchsiz, /kən/, qisqa va deyarli eshitilmaydi. “Can’t” esa to‘liq va uzun, /kɑːnt/. Shuning uchun “I can come” va “I can’t come” ni farqlashda urg‘u va unli uzunligiga quloq soling.
scenes.say: In a sentence, can is weak, /kən/. Can't is strong and long, /kɑːnt/ in British English. Listen to the vowel and the stress to hear the difference.
scenes.say_uz: Gapda can kuchsiz, /kən/. Can't kuchli va uzun, britaniyada /kɑːnt/. Farqni unli va urg‘uda eshitasiz.

scenes.title: Can yoki can't?
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni eshiting. Birinchi: “I can’t swim”. Ikkinchi: “She can drive”. Uchinchi: “We can’t come on Friday”. Har birida “can” mi yoki “can’t” mi? Ayting. Unlining uzunligiga va urg‘uga quloq soling.
scenes.say: One: I can't swim. Two: She can drive. Three: We can't come on Friday. Can or can't each time?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Men suza olmayman. Ikki: U mashina haydashni biladi. Uch: Juma kuni kela olmaymiz. Har safar can yoki can't?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: can’t. Ikkinchi: can. Uchinchi: can’t. Agar sizga qiyin bo‘lsa, tinchlaning, hatto ona tilida so‘zlovchilar ham bu holatda kontekstga tayanadi. Masalan, “but” bor bo‘lsa, ko‘pincha “can’t” bo‘ladi: “I’d love to, but I can’t”. Kontekst va ohang, ikkalasi ham javobni beradi.
scenes.say: One: can't. Two: can. Three: can't. Context helps too: after I'd love to, but, you usually hear can't.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: can't. Ikki: can. Uch: can't. Kontekst ham yordam beradi: I'd love to, but dan keyin odatda can't keladi.

scenes.title: Qanday eslab qolish va yozish
board: Leave a gap and move on
scenes.say_native: Tinglash paytida to‘liq gap yozmang. Faqat kalit so‘zlar va raqamlar: “£9, 7.45, Mon”. Strelka va belgilardan foydalaning. Biror joyni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, to‘xtamang, o‘sha joyni bo‘sh qoldirib keyingi savolga o‘ting. Ko‘pchilik bir xatoda qotib qoladi va keyingi uchta javobni yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: Write only key words and numbers. Use symbols. If you miss something, leave a gap and move on. Do not lose the next answers.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat kalit so‘z va raqamlarni yozing. Belgilardan foydalaning. Biror joyni o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, bo‘sh qoldirib davom eting.

scenes.title: Imlo va birlik xatolari
scenes.say_native: Tinglashda to‘g‘ri eshitib, imlo xatosi bilan ball yo‘qotish juda achinarli. Eng ko‘p xato: “Wednesday” ni “Wensday”, “February” ni “Febuary” deb yozish. Ular yozilishidan farqli talaffuz qilinadi, shuning uchun alohida yodlang. Ikkinchi xato: birlikni tushirib qoldirish.
scenes.say: Check your spelling. Wednesday and February are spelled differently from how we say them. Also copy the unit if it is not already printed on the answer sheet.
scenes.say_uz: Imloni tekshiring. Wednesday va February aytilishidan boshqacha yoziladi. Birlik yozilmagan bo‘lsa, uni yozing.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi tinglash: til kursiga yozilish
scenes.say_native: Murakkabroq tinglash. Qabul bo‘limidagi xodim til kursiga yozilayotgan mijoz bilan gaplashmoqda. Savollar: mijozning ismi, kurs boshlanish kuni, nega bu kursni tanlagani va to‘lov summasi. Ismni harflab aytishadi, shuning uchun yozishga tayyor turing. Raqam va tuzatishlarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Could I have your surname, please? It's Nowak, N-O-W-A-K. Thank you. The course starts on the fourteenth of October. Sorry, the fifteenth. And why did you choose it? I need English for my new job. The fee is three hundred and eighty pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Familiyangizni aytsangiz bo‘ladimi? Nowak, N-O-W-A-K. Rahmat. Kurs 14-oktyabrda boshlanadi. Kechirasiz, 15-oktyabrda. Nega buni tanladingiz? Yangi ishim uchun inglizcha kerak. To‘lov uch yuz sakson funt.

scenes.title: Javoblarni toping
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol: familiya, boshlanish sanasi, sabab va to‘lov. Javobni xotirangizdan yoki yozuvingizdan ayting. Tuzatilgan sana qaysi edi va to‘lov sonini “eighty” bilan “eighteen” ni adashtirmay ayting.
scenes.say: Question one: what is the surname? Question two: when does the course start? Question three: why did the customer choose it? Question four: what is the fee?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: familiya? Ikki: kurs qachon boshlanadi? Uch: nega bu kursni tanladi? To‘rt: to‘lov qancha?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Nowak. Ikkinchi: o‘n beshinchi oktyabr, chunki avval o‘n to‘rtinchi deyildi, keyin “Sorry” bilan tuzatildi. Uchinchi: yangi ish uchun, “for my new job”. To‘rtinchi: uch yuz sakson funt, “three hundred and eighty”, “eighty” da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda.
scenes.say: One: Nowak. Two: the fifteenth of October, after the correction. Three: for a new job. Four: three hundred and eighty pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Nowak. Ikki: 15-oktyabr, tuzatishdan keyin. Uch: yangi ish uchun. To‘rt: uch yuz sakson funt.

scenes.title: Ishlatilgan strategiyalar
scenes.say_native: Bugungi strategiyani birlashtiramiz. Birinchi: savollarni oldindan o‘qing. Ikkinchi: javob turini taxmin qiling. Uchinchi: signal so‘zlar va tuzatishlarni tinglang. To‘rtinchi: faqat kalit so‘zlarni yozing. Beshinchi: oxirida tekshiring. Yangi lug‘at yo‘q, yangi qoida ham yo‘q, faqat tartibli yondashuv.
scenes.say: Here is your strategy. Read the questions first. Predict the answer type. Listen for signposts and corrections. Write key words only. Then check your answers.
scenes.say_uz: Mana strategiyangiz. Avval savollarni o‘qing. Javob turini taxmin qiling. Signal so‘zlar va tuzatishlarni tinglang. Faqat kalit so‘zlarni yozing. Keyin tekshiring.

scenes.title: Javoblarni tekshirish
board: Does it fit? (a number for 'how many')
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi qadam: tekshirish. Birinchi savol: javobim savolga mosmi? “How many” ga raqam, “who” ga ism bo‘lishi kerak. Ikkinchi: javob joyiga grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri keladimi, ot, raqam yoki fe’l? Uchinchi: imlo, birlik va so‘z chegarasi, masalan “ikki so‘zdan ko‘p emas”.
scenes.say: Check that each answer fits the question, fits the sentence grammatically, and has the right spelling and units. Never leave a blank. A guess is better than nothing.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir javob savolga mosligini, grammatik to‘g‘riligini, imlosi va birligini tekshiring. Bo‘sh qoldirmang. Taxmin bo‘sh joydan yaxshi.

scenes.title: Uchinchi tinglash: sayohat e’loni
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi tinglash. Bekatdagi e’lon. Uch savol: qaysi platforma, kechikishning sababi nima va yangi vaqt qanday. E’lonlarda raqamlar tez aytiladi, shuning uchun savol turlarini oldindan o‘ylab oling. Sababni va tuzatishni payqang.
scenes.say: Attention, please. The ten forty to Leeds will now leave from platform fourteen, not platform four. The train is delayed because of a signal failure. It is expected to leave at eleven fifteen. We apologise for the delay.
scenes.say_uz: Diqqat, iltimos. Leedsga o‘n qirq reysi endi to‘rtinchi emas, o‘n to‘rtinchi platformadan jo‘naydi. Poyezd signal buzilishi tufayli kechikmoqda. U o‘n bir o‘n beshda jo‘nashi kutilmoqda. Kechikish uchun uzr so‘raymiz.

scenes.title: Mustaqil javob bering
scenes.say_native: Uch savolga javob bering. Birinchi: qaysi platforma? Ikkinchi: kechikishning sababi nima? Uchinchi: poyezd soat nechada jo‘naydi? Platformani “fourteen” va “four” orasidan adashmay tanlang va sabab so‘zini eslang.
scenes.say: Question one: which platform? Question two: why is the train delayed? Question three: what is the new time?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: qaysi platforma? Ikki: nega kechikmoqda? Uch: yangi vaqt qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: o‘n to‘rtinchi platforma, “fourteen”, “not platform four” dan keyin. Ikkinchi: signal buzilishi, “because of a signal failure”, bu yerda “because of” dan keyin ot keldi. Uchinchi: o‘n bir o‘n besh. Eslang, “ten forty” bu eski vaqt edi, yangi vaqt oxirida aytildi.
scenes.say: One: platform fourteen. Two: a signal failure. Three: eleven fifteen. The old time was ten forty, but the new time came at the end.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: o‘n to‘rtinchi platforma. Ikki: signal buzilishi. Uch: 11.15. Eski vaqt 10.40 edi, yangi vaqt oxirida aytildi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: o‘zingiz e’lon yozing
board: Say a short message with: a name, a number, a time, a reason
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy nutq vazifasi. Qisqa xabar ayting, unda ism, raqam, vaqt va sabab bo‘lsin. Masalan, uchrashuvni kechiktirishingiz haqida, tuzatish bilan: “because”, “sorry”, “actually” ni ishlating. Bu bilan siz teskari tomondan ham tinglovchining ishini yengillashtirishni o‘rganasiz.
scenes.say: Say a short message with a name, a number, a time and a reason. Use because, sorry and actually. Imagine you are changing a meeting.
scenes.say_uz: Ism, raqam, vaqt va sabab bilan qisqa xabar ayting. Because, sorry va actually dan foydalaning. Uchrashuvni o‘zgartiryapsiz deb tasavvur qiling.

scenes.title: Namuna xabar
board: Hi, this is Dilnoza. The meeting is at 3. Sorry, actually 3.30, because of a delay.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Hi, this is Dilnoza. The meeting is at three. Sorry, actually three thirty, because of a delay”. Unda ism bor, vaqt bor, tuzatish bor va sabab bor. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Muhimi, oddiy tuzatish iboralari va sabab so‘zlari ishlatilgan.
scenes.say: Hi, this is Dilnoza. The meeting is at three. Sorry, actually three thirty, because of a delay. See? A name, a time, a correction and a reason.
scenes.say_uz: Salom, men Dilnozaman. Uchrashuv uchda. Kechirasiz, aslida uch o‘ttizda, kechikish tufayli. Ism, vaqt, tuzatish va sabab bor.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Read the questions first · predict the answer
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: audio oldidan savollarni o‘qing va javob turini taxmin qiling. Ikkinchi: raqamlarni, thirteen va thirty kabi, urg‘u orqali farqlang. Uchinchi: signal so‘zlar va tuzatishlarni tinglang, birinchi eshitganingiz ko‘pincha javob emas. To‘rtinchi: sabab so‘zlarini bilib oling, kalit so‘zlarni yozing va oxirida tekshiring. Bu odatlar tinglashni sezilarli yaxshilaydi.
scenes.say: Today you practised listening for numbers, names and reasons, predicting answers, using signpost words and checking your work. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun raqam, ism va sabablarni tinglashni, javobni taxmin qilishni, signal so‘zlarni ishlatishni va tekshirishni mashq qildingiz. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: istalgan qisqa inglizcha audioni tanlang va oltita tafsilot savoliga yozma javob bering, masalan ikkita raqam, ikkita ism yoki joy va ikkita sabab. Avval savollarni yozing, keyin taxmin qiling, so‘ng tinglang va javoblarni tekshiring. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida beshta javob to‘g‘ri. Keyingi darsda taqqoslash va farqlashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, choose a short audio and answer six detail questions. Write the questions first, predict the answers, then listen and check. Next time we will learn to compare and contrast.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: qisqa audioni tanlab, oltita tafsilot savoliga javob bering. Avval savollarni yozing, taxmin qiling, keyin tinglab tekshiring. Keyingi darsda taqqoslash va farqlashni o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: Qisqa inglizcha audioni tanlang va oltita tafsilot savoliga yozma javob bering: raqam, ism yoki joy va sabab bo‘yicha. Avval savollarni yozing va javob turini taxmin qiling, keyin tinglang va tekshiring. Kamida beshta javob to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda taqqoslash va farqlashni o‘rganamiz.
